column1: # Pictures of the original that the game no longer draws: the ones with lettering baked in (a
# text-free copy in `crates/f4x-client/assets/` and a text key replace each) and the ones nothing
# reads. `f4x-extract art` and `f4x-extract refile` put them in `assets-unused/` beside
# `assets-local/`, where they stay for reference and as the sources of `scripts/button_text_free.py`.
# Found by `scripts/unused_art.py` (pictures no run of the client reads) and checked by hand.
# Columns: lbx (lower case), first entry, last entry, the picture's name (screen/name).
